lots.guide_summary: All AUD, no conversion. Four close Gowans SOLD results for boxes or quantities of fly fishing books in the last 8 months: $80, $110, $110, $120 hammer. Wider category ranges $10 to $250 (small lots with Tasmanian titles at the top, general trout/fishing boxes as low as $10-30, including two soft results last week). No UNSOLD or ASKING evidence (web search capped).
lots.working: Keep: lowest close SOLD = $80 (lot 423013) / 1.198 = $66.78, round down to $65 (all-in about $78). Flip: likely resale about $100 hammer if re-auctioned at Gowans (median of close sales), less about 20% selling fees = $80, no outbound postage (local re-auction); $80 / 2.396 = $33.39, round down to $30. Flip margin is thin; this is a keep for someone who fishes.

lots.guide_summary: All AUD, no conversion. Eight close Gowans SOLD results (one lot of Huon panelling boards at $45 and seven bundles of Huon lengths at $30 to $130, most $30 to $65, several with 0 bids recorded). Wider Huon quantities $15 to $170. No UNSOLD or ASKING evidence (web search capped). All of this assumes the boards really are Huon pine.
lots.working: Keep: lowest close SOLD = $30 (lots 394629, 394639) / 1.198 = $25.04, round down to $25. Flip: likely resale about $60 hammer at Gowans (middle of close sales), less about 20% fees = $48, no postage (local); $48 / 2.396 = $20.03, round down to $20. Both only apply if confirmed Huon; if it is radiata or another common pine the lot is worth well under $20.
lots.confidence_reason: Species not confirmed: boards show prominent growth rings, several dark knots and pinkish heartwood streaks, which look more like radiata, Oregon or another common softwood than Huon pine (normally fine, faint-ringed, pale straw colour with few knots). Comparables have no descriptions or sizes.
lots.key_photo_findings: Chalk 1420 23/10. About 10-12 VJ boards, unfinished, roughly 90-140 mm wide. Enlarged crop: distinct cathedral grain and growth rings, at least three round dark knots (one with a hole), reddish-brown stain or old paint on edges, one board with yellow marking. Grain and knots argue against Huon.
lots.condition: Used or offcut lining boards, some edge staining, knots, unfinished faces. Lengths uneven.
lots.question_for_gowans: Is the vendor confident this is Huon pine (it shows strong grain and knots)? What are the board widths and lengths and is the tongue and groove intact? At viewing, smell a fresh scrape: Huon has a strong oily, peppery scent.
